content: .{@-शत्रुः@} .²1 an enemy or destroyer of Indra (when the accent is on the last syllable), an epithet of प्रह्लाद; इन्द्रशत्रो विवर्धस्व मा चिरं जहि विद्विषम् <ls>Bhāg. 6. 9. 12</ls>. बलिप्रदिष्टां श्रियमाददानं त्रैविकमं पादमिवेन्द्रशत्रुः <ls>R. 7. 35</ls>. .²2 [इन्द्रः शत्रुः यस्य] one whose enemy is Indra, an epithet of वृत्र (when the accent is on the first syllable). [This refers to a legend in the <ls>Śat. Br.</ls>, where it is said that Vṛtraʼs father intended his son to become the destroyer of Indra, and asked him to say इन्द्रशत्रुर्वधस्व <ab>&c.</ab> but who, through mistake, accented the word on the first syllable, and was killed by Indra; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Śik. 52</ls>; मन्त्रो हीनः स्वरतो वर्णतो वा मिथ्याप्रयुक्तो न तमर्थमाह . स वाग्वज्रो यजमानं हिनस्ति यथेन्द्रशत्रुः स्वरतोऽपराधात् ..].
